title: Order fulfilment
subtitle: From a tap in the app to a parcel on its way

nodes.label: Shopper
nodes.detail: Places the order from the mobile app.

nodes.label: Orders service
nodes.detail: Owns the order lifecycle. Writes every state change to the orders table and emits an event per transition.

beats.title: The shopper taps Buy
beats.caption: The app builds the order from the basket.

beats.title: The app calls the API
beats.caption: One POST with an idempotency key.

beats.title: The gateway forwards it
beats.caption: After checking the token and the rate limit.

beats.title: 201 goes back
beats.caption: The reply carries the order id.

beats.title: The shopper sees a receipt
beats.caption: This hop plays backwards: the reply runs against the arrow.

beats.title: An event leaves the core
beats.caption: order.placed, published once the write commits.

beats.title: The whole core
beats.caption: Three services, one database, one bus.
